paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.67 as of 2026-08-26, with a decrease of 5.74% from the prior close and 21.65% over the last 23 sessions.

There have been no new news headlines in the last 24 hours, but recent news includes the appointment of Lee McIntire as Interim CEO and the company receiving a US subpoena tied to Project Matador, as reported by The Globe and Mail and Bloomberg, respectively.

Recent SEC filings include a Form 4 filed on 2026-08-18, a Form 10-Q filed on 2026-08-14, and multiple 8-K filings, one of which discloses the appointment of Lee McIntire as CEO with an annualized base salary of $750,000, and another which discloses the company's financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.
